## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `structural-analogical-recall`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-07T20:06:11.214Z.

Algorithm (10) structural fingerprints for analogical recall (Weisfeiler-Leman relational hashing). Serves pm-vvib candidate subsystem (11): retrieve past episodes whose relational SHAPE matches the current situation, independent of vocabulary. Index side: for every item, extract its typed local neighborhood (parent/child edges, dep kinds, status-transition sequence from history, close_reason class, link types) and run k rounds of WL label refinement — each round rehashes an item label with the multiset of its neighbors' labels, so after k rounds the label encodes the k-hop relational shape. The resulting multiset of subtree hashes is the item's structural fingerprint. Similarity = weighted Jaccard over fingerprints; MinHash + LSH banding gives sublinear candidate lookup, so analogical recall is one more bounded-quota source in the two-stage funnel (7), fused via RRF (5) with semantic and associative channels. Costs compose with the existing plan: fingerprints fold incrementally at write time (6) — a mutation re-refines only the k-hop neighborhood it touched; sketch-backed state (8) bounds index size at million-item scale; packing (4)/(9) treats a retrieved precedent as one candidate whose payload is the episode digest (resolution + top learning), never the raw subgraph. Explainability preserved (3): the matched WL subtree hashes decode to which relations aligned ("both had a wontfix blocker feeding a release-gated dependent"), rendered as one line in --explain-ranking. Spectrum behavior: small workspaces have few distinct shapes so candidates collapse into recency/semantic ranking (signal silent, zero cost); decades-scale workspaces get case-based precedent recall no content signal can produce. Distinct from (2) spreading activation (connectivity along EXPLICIT shared edges; this matches shape between DISCONNECTED regions) and from embedding similarity (content, not structure).

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.

value.text: Primary-method check: the WL subtree-kernel formulation scales with edges times refinement rounds; https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v12/shervashidze11a.html . For this experiment, cap neighborhood radius, visited edges and refinement rounds, and version node/edge labels. Structural similarity is candidate evidence, not a proof of graph isomorphism or task relevance. Include structurally similar but semantically wrong episodes and semantically relevant but structurally different episodes as negative and recall controls. Report hash collisions and feature truncation explicitly.
